note: Appended. Records what two real GitHub Actions runs established about the Make -> GitHub leg. It corrects a claim made in an earlier evidence file in this directory; the earlier file is left as written, because it was accurate about what was known at the time.
headline: The Make -> GitHub hop is OPEN, and the earlier AUTH BLOCKER call was wrong.

correction.previously_recorded: live-actions-run-credential-state.json states: 'AUTH BLOCKER ... this environment holds no token with contents:write' and 'A real repository_dispatch has not been received by this workflow.'
correction.what_was_actually_true: Both statements were correct about the AUTHORING SANDBOX, which genuinely has only placeholder tokens. The unexamined assumption was that this extended to GitHub Actions - that a repository_dispatch POSTed with the workflow's own token would be suppressed, as GitHub's recursive-trigger protection would suggest. It was not. A dispatch sent from inside a workflow created a real run.
correction.why_it_matters: The blocker was misfiled. It was reported as 'GitHub needs a personal access token', which would have sent the owner to mint one. GitHub needs nothing. What is actually missing sits entirely on the other two sides: a credential for Make to call GitHub with, and a store for the run to write to.
correction.lesson: The earlier conclusion was reasoned from documentation rather than measured. The probe that settled it costs one workflow run.

probe.method: POST /repos/stratumpraxis/stratum-praxis/dispatches with ${{ github.token }}, then query for runs created since the POST.
runner_output: dispatch accepted; waiting to see whether a run appears
##[notice]the Make -> GitHub hop can be closed with the workflow token

what_happened: Contracts hold: SUCCESS (market contract tests, evidence integrity, engine suites)
Ingest external signals: ran and selected the dispatch source from the event
BLOCKED at the store gate: store_kind UNCONFIGURED, no signal persisted
real_repository_dispatch_run.reading: The route works end to end into MARKET. It stops exactly where it should when there is nowhere durable to write. This is the first repository_dispatch this workflow has ever received.
real_repository_dispatch_run.not_claimed: This dispatch came from a workflow in this repository, not from Make. What is proven is that GitHub accepts the hop and runs MARKET on it. Make's own leg - its scenario POSTing with its own credential - is still unproven.

dispatch_path_on_a_real_runner.why: Until this run, staging the client_payload, running --source dispatch and reporting refusals had never executed in Actions. The code that will handle every signal Make sends had only ever run in an authoring sandbox.
dispatch_path_on_a_real_runner.payload: Two events: one legitimate BUYER_DEMAND carrying a correlation_ref, and one PAYMENT claiming a Stripe charge that the bus is not entitled to assert.

observed.decision_reason: demand present but no existing asset cleared the routing floor

refused.detail: a PAYMENT signal is produced by reading the payment provider, never by a dispatch payload

dispatch_path_on_a_real_runner.significance: The forged payment was refused on a GitHub-hosted runner, surfaced as a workflow warning. Until now that refusal had only ever fired in a sandbox. The rule that stops the event bus minting revenue is enforced in production.
dispatch_path_on_a_real_runner.store: LOCAL_FILE - this run passed local=true, so nothing was written to production state.

what_is_still_blocked.supabase: No SUPABASE_URL or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY. The schema of public.market_event_ledger cannot be read, so the unique constraint on signal_id can neither be verified nor added, and row_count remains 0. Every dispatch run will stop at the store gate until this exists.
what_is_still_blocked.stripe: No STRIPE_SECRET_KEY. The clicks-versus-payments question stays open.
what_is_still_blocked.posthog: No POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY or POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID in Actions. Separately, a PostHog connector is installed for the account but is not enabled in this chat, so its tools are not loaded here either.
what_is_still_blocked.make: No webhook URL, API access or connector reachable from this session, so the Make scenario cannot be inspected or modified. Its GitHub leg needs a credential of its own; the workflow token proved the hop but is not available to Make.
what_is_still_blocked.checked_and_empty: Zapier is connected but has zero authenticated apps (auto_provision_mcp returned none), so it offers no path to Make, Supabase or Stripe.

state_machine_reached.furthest_this_session: QUALIFIED on the real-runner dispatch; ACTIONABLE remains the furthest reached overall, from an earlier local run.
state_machine_reached.why: HUMAN_SIGNAL and CHECKOUT need a live PostHog read; PAID and WON need a Stripe payment record. None may be simulated.

next_blocker: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as repository secrets, plus a unique constraint on signal_id in public.market_event_ledger. With the hop now proven open, the ledger is the only thing standing between a dispatch and a durable row.
